_doc: Rosace art-rule checklist. Every rule in docs/character/ART-RULES.md has one entry here with its severity and HOW TO CHECK it. method: auto = a script can decide pass/fail; semi = a script measures and a person confirms; critic = only a human or critic eye can judge. tool_status: exists = tools/art-construct already computes the metric; exists_partial = the measurement exists but the pass/fail wrapper or the ids/face input does not; to_build = planned in tools/art-construct/rules_check.py (the rule prints SKIP until it is written); n/a = critic only. Thresholds are copied from ART-RULES.md; when a rule changes there, change it here in the same edit and add a learning-log row. basis tags: M measured, S <key> sourced (ART-RULES section 12), I inference, Dex = Dex's direction, other doc names point to that doc.

severity.block: the drawing is rejected; fix before any review
severity.major: fix before a critic round unless the pose notes give a reason
severity.minor: polish; allowed if deliberate and written down

units.rows_above_chin: face rows counted up from the chin row = 0

inputs.sprite.png: native-grid RGBA frame at H 144, palette-exact
inputs.ids: material-id map on the native grid (the render's id pass downsampled, or written by the construct tools per authored pixel)
inputs.render still / render meta: the 3D reference frame and its meta.json (camera, light_cam); reference only
inputs.pose.json: [I, proposed schema] construct wireframe: landmarks {crown, skull_top, chin, pit_neck, shoulder_near/far, elbow_near/far, wrist_near/far, hand_near/far {kind, palm_box, thumb_wedge, knuckle_side}, hip_near/far, crotch, knee_near/far, heel_near/far, sole_y}, weight_foot, foot boxes, loa [3 points], head_axis, neck_axis, torso_centerline, haft {butt, tip}, grips [{hand, point, kind}], gaze_target, expression, intent, carry, move, zones {keep_out: [{name, poly, material?}], must_be: [{name, poly, expect}]}
inputs.face.json: [I, proposed schema] face stamp (PIPELINE 3.10 rows + origin) plus construction landmarks: chin_row, skull_top_row, hair_top_row, centre-line x per row, eye_near/eye_far boxes, face-width row, expression
inputs.construct/faces/*: all expression variants for one facing, for the expression-set and zone-difference checks
inputs.landmarks.json: [built FP2: figure_pose.py -- check / render] per still (render: <view>/px<N>/landmarks.json) or per pose (check): world and screen px at 144 and 80 of pit_neck (jugular notch), neck_base, head_joint, crown, shoulder/acromion/elbow/wrist, hip/asis/knee/ankle/heel/ball/toe per side, bust_apex per side (J_Sec bust bone tail, approximate), com; rig measures (knee and elbow bends, pelvis/chest/head yaw vs camera, chest pitch vs pelvis, head pitch, foot pitch, IK misses, weight leg, pit and CoM over the weight ankle); checks per size for the rig-measurable PS rules. Still to build: bust apex/underbust/collarbone rows from posed mesh cross-sections, and the fill-based rules

metrics.hug_bands: pixel_metrics.py: pairs of equal-start, equal-end runs (>= 3 px) of two colours lying against each other; reported per 1,000 figure px
metrics.clusters: pixel_metrics.py: 4-connected same-colour components; singleton share; strip thickness
metrics.outline: pixel_metrics.py: figure pixels touching background; share with L < 0.03; top colours
metrics.negative_space: to build: fill the figure mask (weapon removed), find background regions bounded by arm and torso ids; area and narrowest width by distance transform
metrics.axes: to build: angles from pose.json landmark pairs
metrics.line_of_action: to build: sagitta = max distance of the 3-point curve from its chord; inflection count
metrics.gaze: to build: per eye, sign of (white centroid x - iris centroid x) in face coordinates
metrics.symmetry: to build: mirror the face stamp about its centre line and list the features that differ
metrics.staircase: to build: run-length sequences along traced 1 px lines; flag non-monotonic sequences and L-corner doubles
metrics.pillow: to build: share of a component's 1 px inner ring in its shadow tones, per side
metrics.zones: to build: point-in-polygon counts for keep-out and must-be zones

rules.rule: Guides before pixels: every pose has a gesture wireframe (pose.json) and every face a construction layer (face.json landmarks); the guide layer never ships.

check.metric: schema check: pose.json has loa (3 points), shoulder/hip/head axes, weight_foot, grips; face.json has the FC-P01 rows and both eye boxes
check.pass: all required fields present; no guide-layer pixels in the shipped PNG

rules.rule: The 3D render is a reference layer only: position, turn, tilt, perspective, overlap order and timing. It never supplies the face or decides attitude; the wireframe wins.

check.metric: pose checks (FG-*) are run on the wireframe, not on the render; face pixels must come from a face stamp, not the render's head
check.pass: FG-P07..FG-P12 pass on the wireframe; the face region's pixels are 100% stamp-authored (touched.json)

rules.rule: Thumbnails: 4-6 gesture wireframes per pose, filled solid at 1x and 3x and scored on the silhouette checks (FG-P13, FG-P14, FG-P11, FG-P08, FG-P09, GR-N02) plus, from round R3, the two checks a head or neck move can break (CL-P05, FG-P12). Keep the best two. Changed in round R3.

check.metric: thumbnails in the gesture spec; each scored on FP.THUMB_RULES + CL-P05 + FG-P12 (figure_r3.py)
check.pass: >= 4 scored, 2 kept

rules.rule: 3 variants per face expression differing on one axis only.

check.metric: variant count and pairwise diff: variants differ in exactly one named axis (eye_row, iris_offset, brow_angle, mouth_corner)
check.pass: >= 3 variants; each diff tagged with its axis

rules.rule: Keep-out and must-be zones per pose and face, checked by script.

check.metric: keep_out: figure pixels (or the named material) inside each keep-out polygon; must_be: the expected material/code present inside each must-be polygon
check.pass: keep_out count = 0 for every zone; every must_be zone satisfied

rules.rule: Order of work: gesture, masses, silhouette, hands and weapon, cloth, face, rendering; failures go back to the owning step.

check.metric: reviewer confirms the construct log shows the steps in order and that fixes were made at the owning step
check.pass: yes

rules.rule: Judge at 1x, 3x, 6x beside 07/08/09 at the same scale, also blurred and greyscale.

check.metric: sheet exists with 1x/3x/6x panels, ref panels at the same pixel scale, a blurred panel and a greyscale panel
check.pass: all panels present; critic verdict recorded

rules.rule: Flip test: mirror the drawing and look again.

check.metric: critic looks at the mirrored sprite and names anything lopsided
check.pass: nothing lopsided, or the fix is logged

rules.rule: Record the winner and the loser and why, in _doc and the learning log.

check.metric: each kept variant has a _doc reason naming a rule ID; the round adds >= 1 learning-log row
check.pass: present

rules.rule: Paint on the construction in layers (head: back hair and neck, face plane, front hair, expression overlays at anchors); read the landmarks off the painted pixels. Added in round R1.

check.metric: face record params.route names the painted route; eye boxes and features present as measured landmarks
check.pass: painted route and measured landmarks

rules.rule: The critic gate: a face or a figure is not done until a whole-drawing pick beside the finish-bar ref, at x3 and 1x, with a stranger's question ("which one would you pull for?"), says so. No checker pass overrides it; a checker fail still blocks. Added in round R3.
basis: M round R2 critique 3: 63/63 automatic face rules passed while the face missed the brief
S saint11-1 (side by side at the same scale)

check.metric: the pick sheet (face_r3.py pick; sheets_r3.py for the figure) and its recorded verdict
check.pass: the shipped drawing is the one picked, with the reason written in the spec and the learning log
check.tool: tools/art-construct/face_r3.py pick (sheet + key.json); the verdict is a person

rules.rule: Paint shading in tone space: a key frame's painted shading shapes name a tone (deep, shadow, lit, highlight) of one material, are masked to it, and carry authored_on (canvas, anchor, pose_sha1); a stale file is skipped. Added in shading round S1.

check.metric: every stroke has mat + tone in {deep, shadow, lit, hi}; authored_on matches the render or the file is reported STALE and not applied
check.pass: all strokes valid; no stale file applied

rules.rule: Head count 6.0 (band 5.5-6.5); h = 24 px skull top to chin at H 144.

check.metric: H / (chin_y - skull_top_y)

rules.rule: Crotch and hanging wrists at the midpoint, 72 px above the sole.

check.metric: sole_y - crotch_y

rules.rule: Knee centre 38-40 px above the sole.

check.metric: sole_y - knee_y for the weight leg
check.pass: 38 <= value <= 40 (+-1 for a bent knee's projection)

rules.rule: Elbow at the waist (y ~58) with the arm hanging; torso thirds end at y ~45/58/72.

check.metric: elbow_y - waist_y for a hanging arm
check.pass: |value| <= 3

rules.rule: Shoulders/waist/hips 27/15/24 px in three-quarter view; rib cage narrower than the pelvis.

check.metric: figure-mask width at the shoulder, waist and hip rows (arms masked out using ids)
check.pass: each within +-2 px; waist < hips; hips < shoulders

rules.rule: Neck width 8-10 px.

check.metric: skin+collar width at the row midway between chin and collar top

rules.rule: One C or S line of action from crown to weight heel; sagitta 6-12 px idle, 15-30 px strike.

check.metric: max distance of the loa curve from the crown-to-heel chord; curve type C (one sign of curvature) or S (one sign change)
check.pass: idle 6-12 px, strike 15-30 px; at most one inflection

rules.rule: Shoulder axis tilted 4-10 deg (2-5 px across 27 px).

check.metric: atan2 of shoulder_far - shoulder_near, in degrees from horizontal

rules.rule: Hip axis tilted opposite to the shoulders, 4-10 deg (2-4 px across 24 px).

check.metric: hip tilt deg and sign vs shoulder tilt sign
check.pass: 4 <= |deg| <= 10 and sign(hip) = -sign(shoulder)

rules.rule: Weight leg within 5 deg of vertical; free knee bent 10-30 deg, 1-3 px lower than the weight knee.

check.metric: weight leg hip->heel angle from vertical; free leg bend = 180 - hip-knee-heel interior angle; knee height difference
check.pass: weight <= 5 deg; free bend 10-30 deg; 1 <= knee drop <= 3 px

rules.rule: Plumb line from the pit of the neck lands inside the weight foot, +-2 px.

check.metric: x(pit_neck) vs weight foot footprint [x0, x1]
check.pass: x0 - 2 <= x <= x1 + 2 (skip if pose.intent in {fall, leap, push})

rules.rule: Head tilted 5-15 deg off the neck axis in idle and hero poses.

check.metric: angle between head_axis (crown->chin) and neck_axis (chin->pit_neck)

rules.rule: Arm-torso gaps in a solid fill: >= 1 in an idle, >= 2 in hero/strike; each >= 3 px at its narrowest and >= 30 px2.

check.metric: enclosed or near-enclosed background regions bounded by arm and torso pixels (arm/sleeve ids vs torso ids), measured on the figure mask without the weapon; narrowest width by distance transform
check.pass: count >= 1 (idle) or >= 2 (hero/strike); each area >= 30 and min width >= 3

rules.rule: Widest body without the weapon >= 0.40 H.

check.metric: max row width of the figure mask with weapon ids removed, divided by H
check.pass: ratio >= 0.40

rules.rule: Feet apart 40-56 px (combat idle); 20-30 px processional only with a bent free knee.

check.metric: |x(heel_near) - x(heel_far)| centre to centre
check.pass: 40-56; or 20-30 with the FG-P10 free-knee bend >= 10 deg

rules.rule: Arm asymmetry: elbow angles differ >= 30 deg; hand heights differ >= 8 px.

check.metric: |elbow_angle_near - elbow_angle_far|; |y(hand_near) - y(hand_far)|
check.pass: >= 30 deg and >= 8 px

rules.rule: In a twist the centre line is an S; the twisted rib cage shows more of one side plane in shadow.

check.metric: inflection count of the torso centre line when rib and pelvis yaw differ by > 15 deg
check.pass: 1 inflection; critic confirms the side-plane read

rules.rule: Strikes: the spine leans into the thrust; near parts bigger and overlapping.

check.metric: angle between the spine (pelvis->pit_neck) and vertical, signed toward the thrust direction (rear grip -> tip)
check.pass: spine leans >= 10 deg toward the thrust side

rules.rule: Idle loop offsets scaled from Slynyrd (head 1-2, shoulders 3, free hand 6, knees 1-2 px; 8 frames, uneven timing).

check.metric: per-landmark max displacement across the loop; frame durations
check.pass: within the table's ranges; frames 5-8 shorter than 1-4

rules.rule: Sub-pixel motion by colour shift; the staff turn is three held poses with uneven timing.

check.metric: critic watches the loop at 1x and 3x
check.pass: reads as alive and as her 'tell'

rules.rule: Never level shoulders over level hips in a standing pose.

check.metric: shoulder and hip tilt (see FG-P08/09)
check.pass: fail if |shoulder deg| < 2 and |hip deg| < 2

rules.rule: Never lock both knees in an idle.

check.metric: hip-knee-heel bend for both legs
check.pass: fail if both bends < 5 deg in an idle

rules.rule: Never mirror the arms or the legs.

check.metric: mirror the far limb landmarks about the torso centre line and compare with the near limb
check.pass: fail if mean landmark distance < 3 px for the arms or for the legs

rules.rule: Never close an arm against the body in a key pose.

check.metric: same as FG-P13, per arm
check.pass: fail if an arm has no gap in a key pose, unless the arm is fully in front of the torso with >= 3 px overlap

rules.rule: Never put the plumb line outside the supporting foot unless falling, leaping or pushing off.

check.metric: same as FG-P11
check.pass: fail if outside by > 2 px and pose.intent not in {fall, leap, push}

rules.rule: Never leave a 1-2 px sliver of background between two parts; separate by >= 4 px or overlap by >= 3 px.

check.metric: tangent scan: background runs of 1-2 px (horizontal or vertical) bounded on both sides by figure pixels of different parts, running for > 4 px along the boundary
check.pass: count = 0

rules.rule: Avoid a perfectly upright head facing straight out in idle and hero poses.

check.metric: head tilt (FG-P12) and head yaw
check.pass: fail if tilt < 3 deg and yaw < 10 deg

rules.rule: Avoid an upright torso over lunging legs.

check.metric: spine angle from vertical when the feet are more than 56 px apart
check.pass: fail if the spine is within 5 deg of vertical

rules.rule: Avoid holding back: if a critic could call it stiff, push one step further and A/B.

check.metric: critic answers 'stiff or alive' at 3x beside 07/08/09
check.pass: alive; if 'stiff', an exaggerated variant is A/B'd

rules.rule: Head size on the appeal stills: hair top to chin / hair top to sole 0.18-0.20 on the standing stills (idle and back, 144 and 80; N1's crouch exempt), about 27-29 px at 144. Under 0.18 (a tilted, chin-down head), scale the head with finish_f2 (1.05-1.15) rather than redraw the face; never over 0.20 (big-headed past ref 07). Added in finish route RF2.
basis: visible RF2: 1.10 won the blind idle set, 1.20 came last (one judge)

check.metric: head_over_H = (facepass chin y - topmost hair/hairtip/veil px) / (anchor y - that top)
check.pass: 0.18 <= head_over_H <= 0.20 on idle and back at 144 and 80

rules.rule: Every hand built per pose from palm box + mitten + thumb wedge + 1 px wrist step; not a fixed block library.

check.metric: each hand record has palm_box, mitten, thumb_wedge and wrist_step fields and was rendered from them
check.pass: all four present; critic confirms the read at 6x

rules.rule: Fist 7-9 x 6-8 px, thumb wedge 2-3 px, curved darker knuckle line with the middle knuckle highest.

check.metric: bounding box of skin pixels in the hand region; thumb wedge pixel count; knuckle line row profile (middle y <= ends y)
check.pass: 7-9 x 6-8; wedge 2-3; knuckle line curved

rules.rule: Open hand 10-12 px long; <= 2 finger separations; fingertip line curved, middle longest.

check.metric: hand length along the forearm axis; count of background notches between fingers; fingertip profile
check.pass: 10-12 px; notches <= 2; middle tip furthest

rules.rule: Hand on hip or at the collar 8-10 px, back of the hand showing, wrist within 30 deg of the forearm.

check.metric: hand bbox length; forearm->hand axis angle

rules.rule: Hand tones: 3 skin tones + 1 line; shadow on the palm side, light on the knuckle plane.

check.metric: distinct skin codes in the hand; centroid of S3/S4 vs centroid of S1/S2 relative to the key light direction
check.pass: <= 3 skin tones + OL; shadow centroid on the side away from the key light

rules.rule: Wrist limits: <= 40 ulnar, <= 17 radial, <= 60 extension, <= 54 flexion.

check.metric: angle between forearm (elbow->wrist) and hand axis (wrist->knuckle), classified by bend direction
check.pass: inside the limits (skip on smear/impact frames)

rules.rule: Never a fist as a rectangle with no thumb wedge or knuckle direction.

check.metric: rectangularity of the fist's skin mask (area / bbox area) and thumb-wedge presence
check.pass: fail if rectangularity > 0.9 or no wedge pixels

rules.rule: Avoid an even row of four finger bumps on an open hand.

check.metric: fingertip profile: count of local maxima, their spacing and heights
check.pass: fail if 4 maxima with equal spacing (+-1 px) and equal heights (+-1 px)

rules.rule: Never pillow-shade a hand.

check.metric: share of the hand's inner ring (pixels 1 px inside the outline) in shadow tones, per side
check.pass: fail if the shadow tone covers > 70% of the inner ring on 3 or more sides

rules.rule: Avoid 1 px fingers that carry shading.

check.metric: 1 px-wide skin strips inside the hand that contain >= 2 skin tones
check.pass: count = 0

rules.rule: Never bend a wrist past the limits, except smear or impact frames.

check.metric: same as HD-P06
check.pass: fail outside the limits unless frame.kind in {smear, impact}

rules.rule: On a 3 px haft the wrist step sits on the back of the fist and the thumb wedge stays inside the fist outline, so HD-P02 (7-9 across) and GR-P06 (>= 2 px each side) hold together. Added in round R1.

check.metric: HD-P02 and GR-P06 on the same fist
check.pass: both pass

rules.rule: Every attack drawing shows both gripping fists, each separated from the belt gold, the hair and the sleeve by at least 1 px of outline (OL on the fist or on the neighbour). Added in glaive-hands round 2.
basis: M glaive-hands round 2 critique 8: on N1 the rear hand dissolved into the gold belt, on N2 into the hair, in the idle into the white bell

check.metric: per gripping fist: hand px, and 4-neighbour contacts between a hand px and a belt-gold / hair / sleeve px (weapon excluded) where neither is OL
check.pass: >= 2 fists on attacks (1 at rest), each >= 20 px at 144 (8 at 80), <= 1 unseparated contact

rules.rule: Hand spacing 24-30 px on a ready or thrust grip.

check.metric: distance between the two grip centres along the haft
check.pass: 24 <= px <= 30 for grip.kind in {ready, thrust}

rules.rule: Hand spacing up to 40 px on a wide sweep.

check.metric: grip distance for grip.kind = sweep

rules.rule: Twirl: both hands within 8-14 px of the haft's middle.

check.metric: distance of each grip centre from the haft midpoint for grip.kind = twirl
check.pass: 8 <= d <= 14 for both

rules.rule: Rear hand in front of the lower belly, at the hip or at the hip crease.

check.metric: distance of the rear grip centre from the hip landmark, or inclusion in the lower-belly box
check.pass: <= 6 px from the hip, or inside the lower-belly box

rules.rule: Both fist centres on the haft line +-1 px; the haft is hidden behind the fingers and collinear on both sides. (This is the hand-on-shaft distance.)

check.metric: perpendicular distance of each grip centre from the fitted haft line (least squares on haft-id pixels); angle difference between the haft segments either side of each fist
check.pass: distance <= 1 px; segment angle difference <= 2 deg; no haft pixels inside each fist's knuckle band

rules.rule: Fist on the haft >= 7 px tall: 2 px knuckles above, 2 px fingers below; thumb wedge crosses the near side.

check.metric: fist skin extent above and below the haft band, measured perpendicular to the haft
check.pass: height >= 7; >= 2 each side; wedge pixels on the haft's near side

rules.rule: Two forward hands: knuckle rows face the same way.

check.metric: knuckle_side field per hand
check.pass: equal; critic confirms

rules.rule: The weapon's weight shows: carry shoulder up 1-2 px; low hold shoulder drops 1-3 px and the torso leans 3-8 deg away.

check.metric: shoulder height delta on the weapon side vs the other; spine lean direction relative to the weapon
check.pass: within the ranges for pose.carry

rules.rule: Rest angle from vertical: processional idle 15-35 deg leaning away from her body; shoulder carry 40-60 deg. (Line angle of the weapon.)

check.metric: haft angle from vertical (butt->tip line); lean direction: tip x moves away from the torso centre line
check.pass: idle 15-35 and leaning away; carry 40-60

rules.rule: Off the grip the haft is 4-8 px clear of the body or overlaps it by >= 3 px.

check.metric: min distance from haft pixels (outside a 6 px radius of each grip) to body pixels; overlap width where they overlap
check.pass: 4-8 px clear, or >= 3 px overlap; never a 1-3 px gap

rules.rule: Never let the weapon float: at least one hand wraps the haft (except N4 vault, Q plant).

check.metric: count of grips passing GR-P05
check.pass: fail if 0 and pose.move not in {N4_vault, Q_plant}

rules.rule: Never run the haft within 10 deg of parallel to the torso, a leg or an arm without a clear overlap (the flagpole).

check.metric: angle between the haft line and each of spine, thigh, shin, upper arm, forearm; overlap flag from GR-P10
check.pass: fail if any angle < 10 deg and they don't overlap by >= 3 px

rules.rule: Avoid the weapon crossing the torso centre band (+-3 px, chest to crotch) in an idle.

check.metric: weapon-id pixels inside the band polygon
check.pass: 0 in an idle

rules.rule: Avoid the coat hanger: one straight line blade tip -> arm -> far shoulder.

check.metric: max deviation of elbow and wrist from the tip->far-shoulder line
check.pass: fail if both within 2 px

rules.rule: Never run the haft horizontally through the pelvis in an attack.

check.metric: haft angle from horizontal and haft pixels inside the pelvis box
check.pass: fail if angle < 15 deg and it crosses the pelvis box

rules.rule: Never ship a grip where the two hands can't be told apart at 3x.

check.metric: critic points to each hand and says which is front and which is rear
check.pass: both identified

rules.rule: Every fold starts at a tension point (collar, armbands, hip band, garter ring, knees).

check.metric: critic traces each fold to its anchor
check.pass: every fold anchored

rules.rule: The tabard hangs from the tilted hip band, off-centre toward the low hip, wrapping the weight thigh.

check.metric: tabard centre x at the hem vs at the hip band, relative to the low hip side; hip band tilt vs the FG-P09 hip axis
check.pass: hem shifts toward the low hip; band tilt within 2 deg of the hip axis

rules.rule: White-on-white overlaps: back part >= 2 ramp steps darker, or a W4 contact line, or a dark accent between.

check.metric: for each border between two white-ramp materials: contrast across the border pixels, or presence of a W4/OL/I line between them
check.pass: every border pair >= 1.9:1 (W1 vs W3) or separated by a contact line

rules.rule: Thigh-highs are the dark indigo ramp; a dark value between the legs; the boot separates from the stocking.

check.metric: stocking-material pixels by code; mean luminance in the between-legs must-be zone; boot/stocking border contrast or gold line
check.pass: stocking >= 90% in I1-I4; between-legs mean L < 0.10; boot/stocking border has a gold line or >= 1.9:1

rules.rule: The collar cross reads: 5x5 at 144 with a dark backing; nothing covers it in front and 3/4 key poses.

check.metric: gold pixels in the cross pattern inside the must-be zone; contrast between the cross and its backing; hand/hair/haft ids over it
check.pass: pattern present (>= 9 gold px in a plus or fleur shape); backing contrast >= 3:1; 0 covering pixels

rules.rule: Never let cloth hang straight through a tilted pelvis.

check.metric: same as CL-P02
check.pass: fail if the hip band is level while the pelvis tilts > 4 deg, or the tabard axis stays vertical

rules.rule: Avoid hair filling the neck and shoulder gap on both sides; keep >= 2 px of neck or shoulder visible on one side.

check.metric: on the rows between chin and shoulder line: skin/collar pixels between hair and background on each side
check.pass: >= 2 px on at least one side

rules.rule: Trumpet sleeves at DESIGN size at 144: about 42 px from the armband to a 27 px mouth, covering the elbow, lower edge hanging by gravity, lining visible in the mouth, gold hem on the rim, pipe folds from the elbow/armband >= 6 px long and 2 px wide. Added in round R1.

check.metric: per sleeve part: height, lining px (I3/I4), hem px (G2/G3)
check.pass: each bell >= 20 px tall; lining >= 6 px; hem >= 6 px

rules.rule: Never hang a CL-P06 bell from a forearm crossing in front of the torso in an idle or hero still; move the hand or pin the bell back. Added in round R1.
basis: M round R1 (thumbnails t1, t3, t6 fail FG-N04)

check.metric: sleeve pixels inside the torso centre band (the GR-N03 keep-out zone)
check.pass: 0 px

rules.rule: Gold trim on light cloth: every 1 px outfit gold pixel (in no 2x2 gold block) takes one tone that separates from each light neighbour at >= 1.5:1 (G2 beside W1/W2/S2, G3 beside W3/S3); a run holds its tone; a G0 glint only alone. Added in outfit art round 1.

check.metric: share of thin outfit gold pixels under 1.5:1 against a 4-neighbour light pixel; tone changes per thin run
check.pass: 0% under 1.5:1; <= 1 tone change per 6 px of run
check.tool: tools/pixel-pipeline/outfit_px.py (applies the rule); tools/pixel-pipeline/outfit_lane.py metrics (gold|white < 1.5 share)

rules.rule: Tabard at size and value: >= 9 px wide at the hem at 144 in front and three-quarter views, a flat centre carrying the cross, folds only from the hip band; its back never within 1.5:1 of the thigh-highs where it shows between the legs. Added in outfit art round 1.

check.metric: tabard part width at its widest row above the V point; contrast of tabard back pixels against touching stocking pixels in the back view
check.pass: >= 9 px at 144 (>= 5 at 80); back/stocking >= 1.5:1
check.tool: n/a (semi: measured on the review/rosace/art/outfit sheets; no script yet)

rules.rule: Vertical grid (rows above the chin): mouth 2-3, nose 6-7, eye bottom 9-11, lash top 13-15, brow lash+2..+3, hair top 29-30.

check.metric: row of each landmark counted up from the chin row (from codes: S4 mouth, S3 nose mark, OL lash top, iris bottom, brow codes, hair top)
check.pass: each row inside its range

rules.rule: Face width at the eye row 15-16 px; (lash top to chin) / width = 0.85-0.95. (The eye-line position ratio.) Round R1: three-quarter ratio; front checked at 0.75-1.0; a profile has no width across the eye row (carried by FC-P01 and FC-P23).

check.metric: (lash_top_row - chin_row) / face width at the eye row (profile: SKIP, round R1)

rules.rule: Centre line in 3/4: a curve ~3/4 across, 1 px inside the far eye's inner corner at eye level.

check.metric: centre-line x at the eye row minus the far eye's inner-corner x

rules.rule: Near eye 5-6 px wide; far eye 1-2 px narrower, 0-1 px shorter. (The 3/4 far-eye width ratio; eye size in px.)

check.metric: eye box widths and heights; far/near width ratio
check.pass: near 5-6; near - far = 1-2; ratio 0.66-0.85; height difference 0-1

rules.rule: Gap between the eyes 3-4 px in 3/4; 5-6 px in front view.

check.metric: columns between the two inner corners
check.pass: 3-4 (q34) or 5-6 (front)

rules.rule: Nose: 1 px or 1x2 S3, 3-4 rows under the eye bottom, on the centre line, 1 px toward the far side.

check.metric: S3 nose pixels: count, rows below the eye bottom, x relative to the centre line
check.pass: 1-2 px; 3-4 rows; x = centre + 1 toward far

rules.rule: Mouth: closed 2-4 px of S4 line (an S3 tip or dimple outside it allowed); the Confident smirk is 4 px of S4 with the near corner stepped up 1 row; open 2 x 2 or 3 x 2. Changed in round R3 (was: at least 3 px).

check.metric: mouth line px (S4/SB/W1) width and corner rows; the S3 tip/dimple is outside the line
check.pass: Confident closed: 4 px, near corner 1 row up; other closed 2-4; open 2-4

rules.rule: Chin point 2-4 px wide, 1-2 px toward the far side; far cheek bulge over rows 8-10; jaw taper from the eye bottom row. The offset and the bulge are three-quarter construction; a front chin sits on the centre line (scope made explicit in round R1).

check.metric: width of the chin's bottom skin row and its centre offset; far contour x over rows 8-10 vs rows 6-7 (q34 only for the offset and bulge; front: chin centred within 0.5 px; round R1)
check.pass: 2-4 wide; offset 1-2 toward far; bulge >= 1 px

rules.rule: Upper lash 2 rows on the outer 2/3 with a flick; almond shape, heavy outer end.

check.metric: upper lash rows from the eye's topmost OL (the flick above the box included) down to the first row with >= 2 iris px; flick pixel outside the box
check.pass: Confident: exactly 2 rows (flick row + 1) and a flick; other open eyes >= 2

rules.rule: Iris 3 px near, 2-3 px far; touches the upper lash; 3 tones + 1 highlight; 5-6 colours per eye.

check.metric: iris width (A2-A4 columns); rows between the lash and the iris top; distinct codes per eye
check.pass: widths in range; gap = 0; 3 iris tones + A5; 5-6 codes

rules.rule: Both irises shift the same direction by the same amount; every still names its gaze target.

check.metric: per eye: sign of (white centroid x - iris centroid x); gaze_target field
check.pass: both signs equal and offsets within 1 px; gaze_target set

rules.rule: Highlight on the same side in both eyes, on the key light's side; never mirrored.

check.metric: highlight column against the iris columns; highlight row against the top full iris row
check.pass: same side both eyes, the lit side, on the iris edge, both on the top full iris row

rules.rule: Resting face open: >= 3 iris rows under the lash. Half-lid (1-2 rows) only on Serene.
basis: M round R1 critique 2a: I3/OL 1.52:1 read as lid

check.metric: rows in each eye box with >= 2 iris px (A2-A5, pupil between them); min over both eyes
check.pass: Confident / open Radiant >= 3; Focused / Ignited >= 2; Serene 1-2

rules.rule: Pupil optional: 1 px darkest iris tone in rows 3-4, in the gaze direction.

check.metric: pupil pixel position vs gaze sign
check.pass: if present, on the gaze side

rules.rule: Brows 3-4 px, 1 px thick, 2-3 rows above the lash top; far brow 1 px shorter; always present, drawn over bangs if needed.

check.metric: brow pixels per side (OL over hair, I3 on skin): length, rows above the lash top
check.pass: present both sides; 3-4 px; 2-3 rows; far = near - 1

rules.rule: Skin: S2 lit plane; a designed cast shadow under the fringe (>= 12 px of S3 clusters, no single pixels) and one under the chin on the neck; an S1 cluster on the lit cheek (2-4 px); one S3 cluster under the far cheekbone. Changed in round R3 (the fringe shadow minimum; was: any shadow).

check.metric: face-region code histogram; S3 components (8-connected) touching hair from below; S4 on the neck; S1 count
check.pass: S2 >= 60%; fringe cast shadow >= 12 px with no single-pixel piece; chin shadow present; S1 2-4 if any

rules.rule: Blush: a 2-3 px horizontal hatch on one row, 1-2 rows under the eye bottom, under the outer half of each eye; far one 1 px shorter or equal; only on S2, never on S3; never a diagonal or vertical pair.

check.metric: blush px per cheek: count and rows; S3 neighbours
check.pass: 2-3 px on one row per cheek; none touching S3

rules.rule: No dark line inside the face; a far-jaw line, if any, in S3, never S4.

check.metric: OL or S4 pixels inside the face mask that are not eyes, brows or mouth

rules.rule: The full expression set exists per facing, each differing from Confident in >= 2 zones.

check.metric: for each expression: which zones (brow rows, eye rows, mouth rows) differ from Confident
check.pass: all six expressions present; >= 2 zones differ

rules.rule: At least one asymmetry on hero drawings (head tilt / 1 px eye-line tilt, brow height, mouth corner, eye width). (The symmetry test.)

check.metric: mirror the face about its centre line and diff; list which features differ
check.pass: >= 1 feature asymmetric beyond the 3/4 foreshortening

rules.rule: Never the whites on the nose side of both eyes (divergent gaze).

check.metric: per eye: side of the white relative to the iris, in face coordinates (nose side vs outer side)
check.pass: fail if both whites are on the nose side

rules.rule: Never flip a finished eye to make the other one (the highlight and iris offset mirror with it).

check.metric: FC-P11 and FC-P12 together
check.pass: fail if the highlight sides differ or the iris offsets have opposite signs

rules.rule: Never make the far eye as wide as the near eye in 3/4.

check.metric: far/near width ratio
check.pass: fail if ratio >= 0.95 on a q34 face

rules.rule: Avoid a white row above the iris on calm and confident faces.

check.metric: W1/W2 pixels between the lash row and the iris top
check.pass: 0 on Confident and Serene

rules.rule: Never the highlight mid-iris, on the lash, or in opposite corners of the two eyes.

check.metric: A5 position class per eye (edge, mid, on-lash) and side per eye
check.pass: edge in both; same side

rules.rule: Avoid a 1-row upper lash at 144.

check.metric: OL rows in the lash (FC-P09)
check.pass: fail if 1

rules.rule: Never let the lash touch I4 or OL hair without a skin or I1/I2 pixel between.

check.metric: 4-neighbour contacts between lash OL pixels and I4/OL hair pixels

rules.rule: Avoid a symmetric round-arch lash.

check.metric: lash profile: row of the inner vs outer end; peak position
check.pass: fail if the ends are on equal rows and the peak is centred

rules.rule: Never ship a face outside the FC-P02 ratio.

check.metric: same as FC-P02
check.pass: fail outside 0.85-0.95

rules.rule: Avoid centring the nose between the eyes in 3/4.

check.metric: nose x vs the midpoint of the two inner corners
check.pass: fail if equal on a q34 face

rules.rule: Never a closed mouth wider than 4 px at 144.

check.metric: mouth line px (S4/SB/W1) width

rules.rule: Avoid a nose over 2 px, or in S4 or OL.

check.metric: nose pixel count and codes
check.pass: <= 2 px, S3 only

rules.rule: Never a straight vertical cheek contour > 3 rows below the eyes, or a flat chin row > 4 px.
basis: M round R1 critique 2e: a 3 px chin on a 6 px neck row read 9 px

check.metric: longest straight run on BOTH contours below the eyes; the chin row as it reads (the run of any skin tone on the chin row, neck included)
check.pass: run <= 3; chin row <= 4

rules.rule: Never an S3 ring just inside the face edge (pillow).

check.metric: share of the face's inner ring in S3, per side
check.pass: fail if >= 70% on 3 or more sides

rules.rule: Never a stray pixel inside the face: every pixel is part of a feature or a >= 2 px shading cluster. (Face orphan count.)

check.metric: single-pixel components (8-connected) of any non-S2 code in the face skin, features excluded

rules.rule: Never S4 as a contour inside the face.

check.metric: S4 pixels outside the mouth box, the lower-lash dot and the under-chin shadow

rules.rule: Never a hair lock across an eye or down the face; no hair pixel between the eyes below the lash top.

check.metric: hair-id or I-code pixels inside the eye boxes and inside the between-eyes keep-out box below the lash top

rules.rule: Never a perfectly mirrored face on a hero drawing.

check.metric: same as FC-P20
check.pass: fail if no asymmetric feature

rules.rule: Never change only one zone between expressions.

check.metric: same as FC-P19
check.pass: fail if any expression differs from Confident in fewer than 2 zones

rules.rule: Never a big smile with neutral eyes.

check.metric: for Radiant: mouth width >= 3 with corners up AND lids unchanged from Confident
check.pass: fail if so

rules.rule: Never a still whose gaze has no named target.

check.metric: gaze_target field and FC-P11 consistency with the target's screen side
check.pass: present and consistent

rules.rule: Never the half-lid as the default face.

check.metric: expression used on idle, walk and menu stills; iris rows on the default expression
check.pass: default = Confident with >= 3 iris rows

rules.rule: Never omit the brows.

check.metric: brow pixels per side (FC-P15)
check.pass: present on both sides in every expression and facing that shows the brow line

rules.rule: The eye line and the fringe move together: any change of the eye row moves the bang tips over that eye by the same rows (HR-P04 and FC-N17 still hold). Added in round R1.
basis: M round R1 (eye_row variants broke FC-N17 in 12 of 12 faces)

check.metric: FC-N17 and HR-P04 on the face at its eye line
check.pass: both pass

rules.rule: The eye's value design: the iris top row under the lash is A2 (A2/OL 3.24:1; I3 1.52:1 and A1 1.58:1 read as lid), then A2/A3, and the bottom row carries an A4 crescent (2 px); A5 highlight on the lit edge; the white is one column opposite the gaze, at most 2 rows.
basis: M round R1 (eye_dark won round a)

check.metric: iris top-row codes (A2, no I3); bottom-row codes (A4); whites count and columns
check.pass: A2 top, A4 bottom, whites <= 2 px in 1 column

rules.rule: Profile: nose tip row 6-7 (about 1/4 of the head), bottom lip about row 3, mouth 1 px inside the contour, eye box 4-5 px wide with its front >= 2 px behind the front contour, lash flick back, neck leaning forward. Added in round R1.

check.metric: profile: row of the contour tip between rows 3-12; mouth rows; eye width and set-back from the front contour
check.pass: tip 6-7; mouth 2-4; eye 4-5 wide and >= 2 px back

rules.rule: Hair built in order: skull, hairline, flow lines, clump blobs in one tone, shadow, highlight.

check.metric: critic checks that the construct steps exist for the hair
check.pass: yes

rules.rule: Hair top 2-3 px above the skull ball.

check.metric: hair_top_row - skull_top_row

rules.rule: Bangs: 3-5 clumps, 3-5 px wide at the root, tapering to 1-2 px tips, from a parting or crown.

check.metric: hair runs across the face on the hairline row (roots) and on the row under the lash top (tips)
check.pass: 3-5 roots, inner roots 3-6 px; inner tips <= 3 px

rules.rule: Over each eye the fringe stops above the brow window (never in the eye box, never within 1 px of a brow); a clump beside each eye (within 2 columns of the box) frames it, reaching to within 2 rows of that eye's lash top; skin shows above each eye. Changed in round R3 (was: tips end 1-2 rows over each lash top).

check.metric: hair px in each eye box; the lowest hair row within 2 columns outside the box (the framing clump); face skin in the 3 rows over the box
check.pass: 0 in the box; the framing clump reaches within 2 rows of the lash top; skin above

rules.rule: Sidelocks may cover the near jaw; the far cheek and chin contour stay visible in 3/4.

check.metric: hair pixels over the far cheek contour and the chin point

rules.rule: Clump separators one step darker than the clump shadow, not OL.

check.metric: codes on separator pixels inside the hair mass
check.pass: one step below the local shadow; 0 OL inside the mass

rules.rule: Hair tones I1 lit, I2 mid, I3 shadow; I4 only for lines and deep undersides; >= 1/3 of hair pixels in I1-I2.

check.metric: hair-id pixel histogram by code

rules.rule: Highlight: an angel ring broken into one tapering dash per clump, the dashes on at least 3 different rows following the skull curve, within a 4-row band. Changed in round R3 (was: one band).

check.metric: I0 components in the hair (8-connected), their row span and their top rows
check.pass: one per fringe clump (+-1); within 4 rows; on >= 3 different rows

rules.rule: Tips shift to A3 then A4 over the last 2-4 px. No A2 step (A2 against I1/I2 hair is under 1.5:1, PX-P08; round R1).

check.metric: hairtip-id pixels by code
check.pass: A3 and A4 present on every tip

rules.rule: Never a helmet fringe (one mass with notches).

check.metric: HR-P03 clump count
check.pass: fail if fewer than 3 clumps

rules.rule: Avoid a speckled highlight.

check.metric: I0/I1 hair px with no I0/I1 neighbour in 8 directions

rules.rule: Avoid I4 as a mass tone.

check.metric: I4 share of hair pixels; largest I4 component
check.pass: share <= 15%; largest component <= 20 px

rules.rule: Bang clumps split: at least one of the root clumps splits into two sub-clumps under the roots with tips of different length; the fringe shadow under them is one band >= 2 rows, not specks between tips. (Round R2: was "each of the 3-5 root clumps splits into two 1-2 px sub-clumps", which made the comb.)

check.metric: fringe runs gained from one row to the next, from the hairline down 5 rows
check.pass: >= 1 split

rules.rule: One key light, top-front, same screen side in every frame of a move.

check.metric: light_cam direction per frame; per material, mean luminance of the left vs right half
check.pass: same side every frame

rules.rule: One clean terminator per form; transition <= 1 px on forms < 12 px.

check.metric: per material component: number of distinct lit->shadow boundaries; width of the intermediate-tone band
check.pass: 1 boundary; band <= 1 px on small forms; critic confirms

rules.rule: Cast shadows are designed shapes >= 2 px thick: under bangs, chin, bust, tabard on thigh, sleeve cuff.

check.metric: shadow components at each listed location; max thickness
check.pass: present; >= 2 px thick; critic confirms the shape

rules.rule: 3 tones per material, plus a highlight only on glossy materials.

check.metric: distinct codes per material (tones covering >= 5%)
check.pass: <= 3 + 1 highlight on hair, gold, steel, boots; <= 3 elsewhere

rules.rule: Hue shift 5-20 deg per ramp step.

check.metric: hue difference between adjacent ramp codes per material
check.pass: 5-20 deg (skip near-neutral whites)

rules.rule: Lit -> first shadow >= 1.6:1 on white, skin and gold.

check.metric: contrast between the dominant lit tone and the dominant shadow tone per light material

rules.rule: Tones that must separate at 1x differ by >= 1.3:1.

check.metric: contrast between each pair of adjacent ramp codes

rules.rule: Different materials meeting: >= 1.5:1 across the border, or a line or shadow tone between. (Contrast between adjacent materials.)

check.metric: per material pair: share of 4-neighbour border pixel pairs under 1.5:1 with no line or shadow pixel between
check.pass: <= 10% of border pairs per material pair

rules.rule: >= 3 value groups (dark, mid, light), each >= 15% of the figure.

check.metric: luminance distribution: dark L < 0.06, mid, light L > 0.40
check.pass: each group >= 15%

rules.rule: Brightest tone share <= 3% (mid/dark costumes); on white costumes <= 14% only if the next step down is >= 1.7:1.

check.metric: share of pixels with L > 0.80; contrast from the brightest white to the next white step used
check.pass: <= 14% and next step >= 1.7 (white costume)

rules.rule: Specular: 1-3 px clusters, <= 1% of the material, one per form, lit side.

check.metric: spec-code clusters per material: sizes and share
check.pass: sizes 1-3; share <= 1%

rules.rule: No orphans inside flat areas >= 12 px except AA, eye, highlight or texture pixels. (Orphan-pixel count.) An orphan has no neighbour of its colour in all 8 directions; a pixel on a 1:1 line is not one (round R1: the check had been 4-connected).

check.metric: pixels with no same-colour neighbour in 8 directions, whose 4 neighbours share one other colour, inside a >= 12 px flat area (outside face, eye, OL); round R1: 8-connected

rules.rule: Every shadow shape >= 2 px thick somewhere; no 1 px shadow strip along an outline.

check.metric: per shadow component: max thickness (distance transform); 1 px strips of shadow tone next to OL running >= 4 px
check.pass: max thickness >= 2; 0 strips

rules.rule: Banding <= 3.5 hugging run pairs per 1,000 figure px. (Banding detection.) Line parts at most 3 px thick (the haft) are left out and judged by PX-P21 (round R1 answers O-7).

check.metric: pixel_metrics hug_bands per 1,000 figure px, without material haft (O-7, round R1); the with-haft figure is printed too

rules.rule: Toon chain: <= 32 colours; 95% of pixels in <= 20. Painterly chain (PX-P42, drive 9): no total cap; 5-10 ramp tones plus <= 3 in-betweens per material after the final requantise (lines and face extra).
basis: critic FJ1: 32 and 40 far below the refs
M D9: 118-156 colours, 5-10 tones per material

check.metric: toon: colour coverage; painterly: distinct fill colours per material (lines and face stamps excluded)
check.pass: toon <= 32 total, 95% in <= 20; painterly <= tones + 3 per material

rules.changed: round D9 (drive 9): scoped to the toon chain; the painterly chain budgets per material

rules.rule: <= 4 distinct tones in any 6x6 window, except the face and weapon ornaments.

check.metric: sliding 6x6 window: distinct codes, masked for the face and ornaments
check.pass: max <= 4

rules.rule: Silhouette line 1 px, near-black (L < 0.03) on 50-75% of the outer ring: a line everywhere, broken on the lit side by the material's own darkest tone. Changed in round FG1 (was >= 50% with no upper bound).

check.metric: outline ring: share of ring pixels with L < 0.03 (finish_metrics.py reports the L < 0.06 share, which equals it on our palette)

rules.rule: Sel-out on the lit side only, in the material's darkest tone; never at the ground.

check.metric: non-OL ring pixels: share on the lit half vs the unlit half; non-OL ring pixels on the bottom 3 rows
check.pass: lit share >= 80%; 0 at the ground

rules.rule: G0 and A5 <= 3% of ring pixels (outside the rim-light lab).

check.metric: ring pixel share in G0/A5

rules.rule: Interior lines lighter than the silhouette, in the material's deep tone.

check.metric: OL pixels not on the outer ring and not in face features
check.pass: <= 5% of interior line pixels

rules.rule: Steady step rhythm on lines; no doubles. (Staircase detection.)

check.metric: trace 1 px line segments (outline and interior lines); run-length sequence per segment: flag non-monotonic runs like 2-3-2-1 and L-corner doubles (pixel-perfect test)
check.pass: irregular sequences <= 5 per sprite; doubles 0 except tagged joints

rules.rule: AA interior only, on steps >= 2 px, one halftone, strip <= half the step, max 2 px.

check.metric: intermediate tones between two materials at step corners: location (interior vs ring) and strip length
check.pass: 0 AA on the ring; strip lengths within the rule

rules.rule: 0 dithered pixels on her. A dither alternates in two directions; a 1 px 45-degree line is a line (round R1).

check.metric: checker 2x2 windows that have another checker window beside or below them (two-way alternation), outside face/eye/weapon; components >= 12 px after a 1 px dilation are dithered areas (round R1: 1:1 lines no longer count)

rules.rule: Skin: S1 small, S2 lit, S3 shadow, S4 deep/cast; shadow step reaches 1.6:1 (S4 for cast shadows or a darker S3).

check.metric: skin histogram; contrast of the lit tone vs the dominant shadow tone
check.pass: S1 <= 10%; shadow contrast >= 1.6

rules.rule: White cloth: W1 a highlight, W2 the base; folds W3/W4 with a sharp top edge; never neutral grey.

check.metric: white-material histogram; saturation of the shadow codes
check.pass: W1 <= 20% of white pixels; W2 is the mode; shadow codes not neutral

rules.rule: Stockings on the indigo ramp (I2 core, I1 sheen, I3 shadow, I4 deep), never the W ramp.

check.metric: stocking-id pixel codes
check.pass: 100% in I1-I4 (plus OL and the gold band)

rules.rule: Gold trim reads: 2 px (lit over shade) or a 1 px G2 line; never a 1 px run cycling G1/G2/G3/G0.

check.metric: 1 px-thick gold runs: number of code changes per run
check.pass: <= 1 code change per 6 px of 1 px run

rules.rule: Boots and haft glossy: one sharp streak along the long axis.

check.metric: I0/I1 spec components on the boot and the haft: count and elongation
check.pass: 1 elongated component per form

rules.rule: Steel blade T2-T4 with a 1 px A5 cutting edge.

check.metric: edge-id codes
check.pass: A5 on the edge line

rules.rule: Shadow budget per form: the terminator at a form's 35-45% quantile of the designed light and never past its 50% quantile; cast shadows at most 4 px at 144 (2 at 80); every form keeps a lit mass. Added in shading round S1.
basis: M shading S1: without it 62-71% of the body skin sat in shadow in N1, Q and the back view
visible refs 07/08 (skin a lit mass with shadow shapes)

check.metric: share of each shaded material (skin off the head, white) in its shadow and deep tones, lines excluded; the shading stage reports it per material (rosace_shade 'shadow_share')
check.pass: <= 0.55 per material per still; a critic confirms the lit mass reads
check.tool: tools/pixel-pipeline/rosace_shade.py report; checker metric to build

rules.rule: Dark thigh-highs: the stockings are the figure's darkest cloth, near-black blue-violet on the K ramp, with a narrow cool sheen on the shin and knee and a darker welt band at the top.

check.metric: median HSV value and saturation of stocking pixels (lines and gold excluded)
check.pass: median V 15-30%, median S <= 45%

rules.rule: Value plan: weapon excluded, outline included, >= 25% of the figure at L < 0.10, >= 35% at L > 0.50, gold <= 10%.

check.metric: share of figure px by relative luminance; gold share
check.pass: dark >= 25%, light >= 35%, gold <= 10% (aspirational)

rules.rule: No one-pixel shading clusters on skin and white (8-connected), lines and override-layer pixels left out.

check.metric: count of 1 px tone components among skin/white shading tones

rules.rule: Rim inside the line: at world light no cyan on the outline ring; the rim sits on the first pixel inside it, on the side away from the key light, convex forms only, tinted toward the light (never #fff); <= 6% of the ring at 144, at 80 the hair crown only.

check.metric: cyan px on the ring; rim px / ring px (override layer touched.json)
check.pass: 0 cyan ring px and rim <= 6% of the ring

rules.rule: No skin stripe: no one-tone skin cluster <= 2 px across its limb's axis and >= 6 px along it; limbs shade as cylinders along their own axis with one short highlight lens.

check.metric: per limb (noface_id B) PCA axis; per skin tone component, extent along and across
check.pass: 0 stripes

rules.rule: Value map with one accent: >= 12% of the opaque figure (weapon excluded, outline included) at V < 25%, and fewer than 3 palette colours at S > 60% and V > 30% holding >= 1% each.

check.metric: share at HSV V < 0.25; palette colours with S > 0.6, V > 0.3 and >= 1% share
check.pass: dark >= 12% and < 3 saturated colours

rules.rule: Separation on the combat backdrop: on #dccab0 the torso (bodice white + torso skin) separates by >= 2 value steps (1.3:1 each): its shadow tones and its silhouette line each at median >= 1.69:1 against the backdrop, and <= 35% of the torso within one step.

check.metric: WCAG contrast vs #dccab0: median of the torso's W3/W4/S3/S4 px, median of the ring px beside the torso, share of torso px under 1.3:1
check.pass: shadow >= 1.69, line >= 1.69, near share <= 35%

rules.rule: Coloured line on skin: the outline beside body skin is the skin's darkest shade, not the navy OL; OL only on shadow-side outer tips and ground contact.
basis: M shading round 3: o 0/8, control 4/8, pick 8/8

check.metric: share of OL among ring px whose only figure 4-neighbours are body skin (head part excluded)

rules.rule: Keep the identity hues: whole-sprite mean HSV saturation 0.43-0.50 (within 0.03 of the integrated build) with violet hair, true gold, lilac-shadowed white and dark indigo as anchors; reach the refs' lower chroma by value (big areas low-key, shadows cooler and more saturated), never by greying whole ramps; accent <= 5% where the gold allows (O-34).
basis: M FG1: refs median S 0.15-0.42, chromatic 35-67%, accent 0.4-3.1% (09 20%, its red robe); ours 0.43-0.51, 87-91%, 12-15%
critic FJ1: F1 at median S 0.26 lost her identity at 80; every judge kept current's colour identity
M D9: mean S 0.43-0.48, V<0.35 share within 0.04 of current

check.metric: mean HSV S over figure px; V<0.35 share
check.pass: 0.43-0.50; V<0.35 share >= the integrated build's - 0.03

rules.changed: round D9 (drive 9): old value median S <= 0.35, chromatic <= 70%, accent <= 5%, big areas near-neutral

rules.rule: Dark ramp: the stockings and boots use 3-4 tones between L* 10 and 36 (each >= 10% of the material, outline excluded), mean HSV S <= 0.35 in the darkest and the lightest quarter.
basis: M FG1: refs 3-4 tones over L* 10-36, S 0.13-0.31; ours 2 tones (L* 12, 19), S 0.40

check.metric: materials['dark cloth'].tones90 and mean_S (materials 3 + 9)
check.pass: tones90 >= 3 and mean_S <= 0.35

rules.rule: Skin tones in use: body and face skin use >= 4 tones covering 90% of skin pixels (outline excluded; 1-D clusters of +-5 L*), shadow tones at mean HSV S <= 0.35.
basis: M FG1: refs 07/08/09/04 all 5 tones, shadow S 0.20-0.31; ours 3 tones, shadow S 0.43 (codec control 4)

check.metric: materials.skin.tones90

rules.rule: Supersampled render to pixels: when a sprite comes from a render at 3-4x (route F1), alpha is binary (figure where >= 45% of its block is), the silhouette is never blended with the background (0 in-between ring px), in-between colours come only from interior blocks holding two labels, then an adaptive palette per material group, the 2x2 checker break (PX-P23) and a despeckle run on the result. A plain box or bilinear downscale is never shipped.
basis: M FN1: P0-P4 at 144 and 80 read as pixel art at 1x with alpha only 0/255; the lines and face stamp drawn after the quantise made new two-way checkers until the checker pass ran last

check.pass: >= 2 rows of circlet px at 144, >= 1 at 80; mean light R > 0.1 (not unlit)

check.pass: fringe_shadow >= 1 and hair_aa >= 1 on every still with a visible face

check.pass: hair_clump_px > 0 at 144 and 80; hue order holds

rules.rule: Face form on a painterly face from three authored steps: the head's cast shadow on the neck (2 rows under the chin, 1 at 80, rose #c9868a at 70% then 35%), a jaw step (face skin with no face skin below it, toward the skin ramp's 0.42 tone at 40%), and a finish-drawn blush (2 px under each eye's outer half, 1 at 80, with a 1 px soft ring).

check.pass: <= 2 px for every hand the pose puts on a grip

rules.rule: The rim lives on the outline pixel: in the painterly chain the rim is drawn on the outline pixel of curved forms facing the rim direction (the material's 0.72 tone about 55% toward the rim colour, under 230), 1 px gaps bridged, runs < 3 dropped; never an inset second line. Only on convex peaks: each rim run keeps at most 3 px around its most rim-facing pixel (about 30% of the run, peaks at least 7 px apart), in a warm neutral from the world light (#f0dcc6; hair a quiet lavender), never the blade cyan outside an effect. (Changed in round D9-R4; old: continuous runs in cyan.) Changed in round D9-R5 (old: 3 px kept around each peak, which read as dotted beads): runs under 5 px go back to the outline; a longer run keeps one contiguous arc of up to 7 px from its most rim-facing pixel (a second arc on runs over 22 px).

critic D9-R4 rim 17 (4.5): 'dotted white beads on the dark sleeve edge'

check.metric: r5_rim_arcs kept/reverted/arcs in post.json r3 block (round 5); r4_rim_limit before

rules.rule: Never leave a lit horizontal skin band between the collar and the bodice that runs on into the near shoulder: it reads as a forearm across the top of the bust. Shade the near chest as a side plane stepping into shadow toward the arm, with a 1 px shadow at the chest-shoulder boundary, and dip the neckline into the cleavage.

check.metric: per eye layer: stamp width, rows of the lash key 'K' over the iris, iris rows, catchlight count; at 80 the eye and blush pixels present at x1
